note: Two sources name a different father for the same person. That is the canonical contradiction and must be surfaced as a candidate pair.

statements.text: والد عبدالله هو محمد بن سعد.
والد عبدالله هو عامر بن مالك.

note: The same sentence twice is not a contradiction. A detector that flags it would fill the review queue with noise, which is the failure this case exists to catch.

statements.text: والد عبدالله هو محمد بن سعد.
والد عبدالله هو محمد بن سعد.

note: Two statements about different people cannot contradict each other, however similar their wording.
Three sources: two agree and one differs, so the two disagreeing pairs are the candidates. The agreeing pair is not.

statements.text: والد عبدالله هو محمد، وذكر في موضع آخر.

note: Statements that carry no relation at all cannot be compared, so nothing is proposed.
A dispute over a migration rather than a parentage is still a contradiction the reader should see.
